verdict.rationale: Adyen's docs confirm a payment-links feature and a Customer Area dashboard (adyen-docs-24, adyen-docs-16), but there's no detail on a no-code, self-serve flow, and community evidence indicates Adyen frequently declines small/early-stage businesses and imposes minimum volumes and reserves, undermining the 'founder can start selling immediately' claim (adyen-comm-1, adyen-comm-11). missing for 10: dashboard walkthrough for creating a payment link, confirmation of instant self-serve onboarding for small founders, independent hands-on evidence that a founder without existing volume can actually use it immediately.
